text: There is reward, in Genesis 22, for attention to what is absent. Sarah has no part in the chapter, and in the verse immediately following comes the announcement of her death; the scene thus intimates, though it nowhere affirms, that something in the household did not survive the mountain. At the point where a feebler narrative would dwell upon return and recognition, the narrator turns aside; the silence is charged, for Abraham returns to the servants, and Isaac is not mentioned.
